note: seed 1 of each pose, every 2 frames, for the animation; the table covers all 6 runs. rmsd100 and hinge100 are Angstrom times 100, frames10 SVG units times 10 in the pocket.json view

system.protein: 1M17 chain A residues 672 to 964 (kinase domain), PDBFixer, pH 7.4
system.ligand: erlotinib, docked pose, hydrogens added by RDKit on the docked heavy atoms
system.protocol: minimise, 100 ps NVT and 100 ps NPT with 1000 kJ/mol/nm^2 restraints on protein and ligand heavy atoms, then 2 ns unrestrained NPT, PME 1.0 nm, HBonds, HMR 1.5 amu, 4 fs, LangevinMiddle 300 K 1/ps, MC barostat 1 bar every 25 steps, OpenCL single precision
system.frames: every 10 ps, ligand heavy atoms plus protein CA plus heavy atoms of residues within 8 A of the ligand, coordinates reported without periodic wrapping
system.analysis: every frame superposed on the protein CA of the starting structure, so the coordinates below are in the 1M17 receptor frame

verdict_rule: a pose holds if the median ligand heavy atom RMSD over the last 1 ns is under 2.5 A in at least 2 of 3 seeds, written before any trajectory was run
hinge: distance from the Met769 backbone N to the erlotinib quinazoline N1, in Angstrom
